text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only the sound of tapping keys echoed in the room.
The hands of the clock had already passed midnight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make Gran Alegria win."
With that single-minded devotion, I devise her training routine.
choice_data_list: Alright, your next mock race opponent will be...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"—A race against all of them!?
Oh man! My motivation is going a hundred miles an hour!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Once I'm ready, I'll sprint right over!
Hurry, self, hurry~!!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, as energetic as ever, that one.
And... she has the ability to back up that confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I believe you'll do great things.
Do your best, rookie Trainer!"
choice_data_list: ...Yes, I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While I was preparing for the mock race—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Is it time yet, is it time yet~?!
Gran-san's race!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Calm down a bit! You really
love Gran Alegria, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course! ...Gran-san is
an Umamusume who's gonna make history, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Overhearing the rumors about Gran Alegria, I clenched my fists and began walking toward the track.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're here, you're here!
Trainer, I'm all ready to go~!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: —Waaah! It's your racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer B
text_block_list.text: —We get to watch a race just like the real deal!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! After all, it's a very special
practice race for the Mile Queen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, the reason I asked for a match today was—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is racing, after all.
There's no way any other Umamusume could win.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer D
text_block_list.text:
North Flight isn't going down easy either, right?
Did you see that explosive burst of speed at the end of her practice run!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-senpai is the strongest miler!
She's the one I look up to most~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Of course Digital-san is the strongest!
She's gone toe-to-toe with so many powerhouses!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The crowd size is amazing!
I'm getting 100-mile excited!
choice_data_list: ……You holding up okay with all that pressure?
……Are you okay with the pressure and all?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: It's not that I don't feel anything, but... something like that? Bring it on! You know?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Please take a look at my racing attire.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll always be at the center of the roaring crowd.
That's the vow woven into this GA emblem.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Good mile-ning, everyooonne~♪"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The "Good Mile-ning" is my declaration
that I'm the Umamusume who represents the Mile.
And carrying that vow is the—Good Mile-ning Patch!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I love pressure!
Why do you think that is?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I believe you'll do great things.
Do your best, rookie Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course! ...Gran-san is
an Umamusume who's gonna make history, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I always wanted to "answer" someone's hopes.
The more I thought that, the sweatier my palms became.
Because—
choice_data_list: Pressure is just the flip side of expectations.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's my Trainer for you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't thinking about that give you confidence!?
Everyone wants to see us run!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Every time I put on these clothes, I think to myself:
I'm gonna do it! I'm gonna blow everyone away!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them all in one go!
My running, my strength!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because I am—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am the strongest Umamusume:
Gran Alegria!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Turning even high pressure into her own strength.
At the very core of that—
was an overwhelming, peerless confidence."

I want the same patch too.
That's a really cool racing outfit.
That's such a cool racing outfit, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:
"Turning even high pressure into her own strength.
At the very core of that—
was an overwhelming, peerless confidence."
choice_data_list: I want the same patch too.
I want the same patch too.
That's a really cool racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I actually have a spare!
Let's definitely match!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Please accept my highest hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ! Ehehe, I put a lot of thought into it!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wearing this outfit you complimented me on—
I'm off, Trainer! I'll be sure to bring home 1st place!
